title: The Molossi
summary: A militarized Gulf Coast power bloc commanded by Marcus Georgio in Compromised.

claims.text: Compromised describes the Molossi as a private army assembled around Dallas-Fort Worth by Marcus Georgio after the pandemic, with local JTF elements rallying to it.
The Molossi move into Gulf Coast refinery communities under the language of protection while the rogue cell pressures Georgio to expand their control.

paragraphs.text: The Molossi arrive as a heavily organized alternative to the Division's small cell, offering security to communities threatened by the Reborn.
Their expansion cannot be read simply as an independent takeover: the novel later establishes that rogue leverage against Georgio is driving the movement into the region.

verification.notes: This record keeps the novel's Texas-region scope and does not recast the Molossi as a general game-world faction.
